elements.text: Do you need to updateyour account details?
What to keep in mind for each section of the form:
Need to prove who you are? Our fact sheet explains how:
I want to update details for:
Postal address (if different from your home address)
Your new contact details (only what has changed)
Your new personal details (only what has changed)
New home address (not a PO box)
New postal address (if different from your home address)
Bank account for your income payments
Second bank account (only if you split your payments)
If you have a transition to retirement account
Everyone completes sections 6 to 10 on the next pages.
Choose one of the two options below.
Give your driver licence or passport details, plus your Medicare card if you have one.
Some states print a separate card number on the licence. If yours does, give both numbers.
I consent to electronic identity verification
Full name as shown on driver licence
Full name as shown on passport
Full name as shown on Medicare card
I will provide certified identity documents instead
We act on your request once everything we need has arrived.
If you are under 15, a parent or guardian completes section 9 instead.
Sign in blue or black ink. A digital signature is accepted only on a certified, read-only copy.
Declaration by someone signing for the member
Sign in blue or black ink. A digital signature is accepted only on a certified, read-only copy.
I have read the guide on page 1
I have completed every mandatory field
My name has changed and I have attached evidence
I am signing on behalf of the member and have attached my authority
I have signed and dated the form
I am correcting my name, date of birth or gender and have attached identification
I have asked to change my income payments
